KEN.note: IFMIS is named only as a service county offices can now receive over the network; its use across central government is not stated.

facts.fact: Kenya's government launched phases four and five of the Last Mile County Connectivity Project, which aims to connect 455 county sites and then 660 sites across 110 sub-counties with fibre and public Wi-Fi hotspots, said Head of Civil Service Felix Koskei.

systems.owner: State Department for ICT and the Digital Economy

KEN.note: A Jitume lab was launched at an institute for the blind, but the source states nothing on accessibility or assistive technology.
The source describes last-mile fibre and an intention to deploy NOFBI across 47 counties; no backbone link in service or being built is stated.
